title: CYBRIK inference-plane transport binding (authorization-context view) v1
description: Structural shape of the AUTHORIZATION CONTEXT a relying party (Cyber AI) MUST evaluate for a single presented call on the W2-D inference REST plane, once that plane is bound to the W2-F two-layer trust seam (ADR-0008). It composes, WITHOUT modifying: (1) the mTLS transport channel (E2 workload identity, proof-of-possession thumbprint); (2) the presented W2-F delegation token (cybrik.svc-delegation-token.v1, authoritative identity/authorization); (3) the relying-party context (its own audience + peer certificate thumbprint); (4) the ADVISORY identity the W2-D request body carries (never elevates — must match the token); and (5) the REST/idempotency/deadline/feature-flag/audit-decision transport metadata. Every identity axis is AUTHORITATIVE from the token and ADVISORY in the body; a mismatch MUST be rejected fail-closed. additionalProperties:false everywhere means a forwarded end-user token, static bearer, or model/vendor/tool authority field has nowhere to live. This is a validation/authorization VIEW; it is not itself a wire message and carries no server, host, URL, key, or secret. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain; it is an identifier, NOT an endpoint. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Gate W2-I was decided ACCEPT by the Decision Council / Founder at human boundary HB-4 on 2026-08-20 and applied to these bytes by the recorded W2-I status flip. Acceptance authorizes contract-first implementation only; it is not a stable v1/GA promotion, not an ADR-0001 immutable bundle tag, and not runtime, endpoint, deployment or release authority.

binding_id.description: Caller/relying-party-assigned id for this presented-call authorization context. Correlates the transport decision to audit/eval telemetry. Not authority.

transport.description: The E2 mutually-authenticated mTLS channel the call arrived on. Const protocol 'rest/json' and const mutual_tls true make an unauthenticated or non-REST inference channel structurally inexpressible here (MCP is a Tool/Agent gateway adapter, not this trust boundary). The peer_cert_thumbprint is the SHA-256 thumbprint of the presenter's client certificate; the relying party MUST match it to the token cnf['x5t#S256'] (proof-of-possession).

mutual_tls.description: Const true. A non-mTLS (bearer-only) inference channel is structurally impossible on this seam.

presented_token.description: The decoded W2-F delegation token presented on the call (authoritative). Its claims are the source of truth for tenant/actor/operation/marking; the body below is advisory only.

relying_party.description: The validating service's own context (Cyber AI inference). audience is matched EXACTLY to the token aud (confused-deputy defense); peer_cert_thumbprint is the observed mTLS peer thumbprint (must equal transport.peer_cert_thumbprint and token cnf).

accepted_issuers.description: Pinned issuer allow-list; the token iss MUST be a member. minItems 1 — an empty issuer set trusts nothing.

body_advisory.description: The identity/authorization fields the W2-D request body carries. ADVISORY ONLY: each axis MUST equal (or, for marking, be at-or-below) the authoritative token claim; a mismatch MUST be rejected. additionalProperties:false forbids a forwarded end-user token, static bearer, or any model/vendor/tool/agent authority field from riding along in the identity view.

tenant_id.description: Advisory tenant; MUST equal token cybrik.tenant_id. Never elevates.

actor.description: Advisory actor for audit correlation; authoritative actor is the token cybrik.actor.

org_scope.description: Advisory opaque org hint; when present MUST equal token cybrik.org_scope. Carries no authority (ADR-0007 delta not applied).

operation.description: The requested operation; operation.name MUST equal both the token cybrik.operation.name and rest_binding.operation.name (confused-deputy defense).

data_marking.description: Advisory request marking; MUST be at or below token cybrik.marking on the classification/TLP lattice (marking non-escalation).

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED for create (POST) presentations whose rest_binding declares requires_idempotency_key true (see the TT-4 conditional below); mirrors the mandatory Idempotency-Key header. Same key + same resolved request = same result, never a second billed/side-effecting inference. minLength 16. Not replay authority after the deadline.

deadline_seconds.description: Caller deadline for the call; the relying party clamps to the resolved model class's own timeout and never above it (mirrors W2-D deadline_seconds).

decision.description: The relying party's audited authorization decision for this presented call. Present on the evaluated view; decision_id is echoed on the response so the wire decision correlates to its audit record.

reason_class.description: Present when disposition='deny': the typed class that fired. Absent on 'permit'.

allOf.title: TT-4 create replay control
allOf.description: Cross-object conditional: when the presentation binds a create (rest_binding.method POST) whose policy declares requires_idempotency_key true, the ROOT idempotency_key MUST be present — and, by its own minLength, at least 16 characters. minLength alone never fires on an absent property, so without this conditional a create could omit the key entirely and escape replay control. The condition is a conjunction, so a safe read whose policy declares no key is never forced to carry one; rest_binding's own method/policy agreement rule keeps the two consistent. This subschema restates rest_binding inline only to express the condition; it neither modifies nor re-versions the referenced restBinding definition, and additionalProperties on the root object is unaffected because it is evaluated against the root's own properties.
